description:
FILED s519b (Opus 5.5, s520, 2026-10-18) from the IO-Compress board join -- THE "real CPAN cause line" the s331 ruling waits for (DECIDED: "`like`/`unlike` with a plain STRING pattern follows test.pl (interpolate), both callers -- accepted divergence from Test::More; a dist that passed upstream CI cannot contain the failing spelling.  Revisit on a real CPAN cause line." -> fable-answers-s331.md §3).

IO-Compress-2.214 (a core module's CPAN dist) uses the Test::More spelling `like $got, '/RE/'` throughout: t/005defhdr.t:227 `like $IO::Uncompress::Inflate::InflateError, '/Header Error: CRC mismatch/'`, t/compress/oneshot.pl:69 `like $@, "/^$TopType: expected at least 1 parameters/"`, t/004gziphdr.t's OS_Code 256 row, and many more behind them.  Test::More (Test::Builder::maybe_regex) treats a STRING of the form "/.../flags" (or "m{...}flags") as that regex; PCL's TAP layer treats it as a test.pl-style interpolated pattern, so the slashes are matched literally and the row FAILS.

Reproducer (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL, s519b tree):
  use Test::More tests => 3;
  like("Header Error: CRC mismatch.", "/Header Error: CRC mismatch/", "slash string");   # perl ok, PCL not ok
  like("abc", "/^a/", "anchored");                                                       # perl ok, PCL not ok
  unlike("abc", "/z/", "unlike");                                                        # both ok (by accident)
Board rows citing this task (IO-Compress join): 005defhdr.t 38 41 44, 004gziphdr.t 295, 105oneshot-gzip.t / -zip.t row 4 "No Parameters".

FIX SHAPE (cl/pcl-test.lisp, the TAP layer, NOT test.pl's): when the call is Test::More's like/unlike (the TAP layer serving Test::More), a string pattern that matches Test::Builder::maybe_regex's `^/(.*)/(\w*)$` or `^m([^\w\s])(.+)\1(\w*)$` is compiled as that regex with its flags; perl-tests/t/test.pl's own like() keeps its interpolation (the s331 ruling's "both callers" was about test.pl's like_yn, which is a different function).  Fable decides: this reopens the s331 ruling.  BAR: the three probe lines = perl; the IO-Compress rows above leave the board baseline by edit; the harness legs (sweep + companion --all --quick, the WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN harness row).
subject: Test::More like/unlike with a "/RE/" STRING pattern: perl (Test::Builder::maybe_regex) uses it as the regex, the PCL TAP layer matches the slashes literally -- the s331 "revisit on a real CPAN cause line" trigger: IO-Compress uses the spelling (005defhdr, 004gziphdr, oneshot.pl)
